To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the performance consequences (growth and profitability) of a broad (generalist, national) strategy depend on the competitive environment (i.e. the number of competitors in the industry), (ii) the performance consequences for a narrow (specialist, regional) strategy depend on its position in resource space (i.e. its position in the resource-partitioning model), and (iii) size differences have a negative impact on growth and profitability.

(i) generalist strategies have a positive effect on growth, but not on profitability; (ii) specialist strategies have a positive and significant effect on profitability, but not on growth; and (iii) there is a significant positive effect of size on growth and profitability.
